people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: This is the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt, and my Spirit lived among you. ‘Don’t be afraid.’
translations.bsb: This is the promise I made to you when you came out of Egypt. And My Spirit remains among you; do not be afraid.”
translations.kjv: According to the word that I covenanted with you when ye came out of Egypt, so my spirit remaineth among you: fear
translations.asv: according to the word that I covenanted with you when ye came out of Egypt, and my Spirit abode among you: fear ye not.
